content: निकाम {%a.%} [नि कम् घञ्] .²1 Plentiful, copious, abundant; निकामजलां स्रोतोवहाम् <ls>Ś. 6. 16</ls>. .²2 Desirous of. .{@-मः, मम्@} Wish, desire; हातुं प्रचक्रमे राजा तां पुरीमनिकामतः <ls>Bhāg. 4. 28. 10</ls>. .{@-मम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 According to oneʼs wish or desire, agreeably to desire. .²2 To oneʼs satisfaction, to the heartʼs content; रात्रौ निकामं शयितव्यमपि नास्ति <ls>Ś. 2</ls> ‘I cannot even sleep at ease or comfortably at night’. .²3 Very much, exceedingly; निकामं क्षामाङ्गी <ls>Māl. 2. 3</ls>; often used as the first member of <ab>comp.</ab> when it loses its final म्; निकामनिरङ्कुशः <ls>Gīt. 7</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 23</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 54</ls>.
